items.t: Is a co-chair of the newly formed bipartisan, bicameral Criminal Justice Reform Caucus of Minnesota state legislators.
items.q: Rep. Jamie Long (DFL – Minneapolis), Rep. John Poston (R – Lake Shore), Sen. Ron Latz (DFL – St. Louis Park), and Sen. Roger Chamberlain (R – Lino Lakes) will serve as co-chairs of the Criminal Justice Reform Caucus.

items.t: Introduced legislation to cap probation at five years.
items.q: Earlier this year, Rep. Long introduced legislation to cap probation at five years.

record.office: Majority Leader, Minnesota House of Representatives
record.t: Was chosen by DFLers as the next majority leader of the Minnesota House of Representatives after the 2022 election (2023).
record.q: DFLers also chose Rep. Jamie Long (DFL-Mpls) to be the next majority leader, succeeding current House Majority Leader Ryan Winkler (DFL-Golden Valley), who did not seek re-election

record.t: Was chosen by the House DFL caucus as majority leader for the 2027-2028 legislative session.
record.q: The caucus also chose Rep. Jamie Long (DFL-Mpls) as majority leader, and Rep. Samantha Sencer-Mura (DFL-Mpls) as majority whip for the 2027-2028 legislative session that begins Jan. 12.

record.t: Presented HF3477, which would create a cause of action for violations of civil rights under color of law, to the House Judiciary Finance and Civil Law Committee.
record.q: House DFL Floor Leader Jamie Long presents HF3477 to the House Judiciary Finance and Civil Law Committee Feb. 24. The bill would create a cause of action for violations of civil rights under color of law.
